name: WonderTax Labs: Audita™
author: wondertaxlabs

sections.description:
Audit the Sales Tax Your Store Charges

WonderTax Labs: Audita™ feeds your WooCommerce orders to WonderTax Labs Audita™, which audits the sales tax your store charges on every order against the tax each order owes.

Features

  • Sales Tax Auditing – Every order is audited by Audita™: the tax your store charged against the tax the order owes
  • Block Checkout Support – Full compatibility with WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks
  • Automatic Order Sync – All orders automatically synced to WonderTax Labs Audita™ for auditing
  • Multi-Jurisdiction Support – Handles complex tax scenarios across all US states and jurisdictions
  • Historical Order Import – Import and analyze past orders for comprehensive tax compliance
  • Secure Integration – Enterprise-grade encryption for all credentials and data transmission
  • Easy Setup – Connect from your WordPress admin in a few clicks
  • Checkout Tax with Reporta™ – With a Reporta™ account, WonderTax Labs answers your checkout tax (see External Services)

How It Works

  1. Install & Connect – Install the plugin and connect your store to WonderTax Labs
  2. Automatic Auditing – All orders are automatically fed to Audita™, which audits the tax your store charges
  3. Stay Compliant – WonderTax Labs handles the complexity of multi-state tax compliance

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 8.0 or higher
  • PHP 8.0 or higher
  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • HTTPS-enabled site
  • WonderTax Labs account (sign up at app.wonder.tax)

Privacy & Security

This plugin connects to WonderTax Labs (app.wonder.tax) to provide sales tax auditing and compliance services. When you connect your store:

  • Order data (customer location, product details, amounts) is sent to WonderTax Labs
  • All data is transmitted securely over HTTPS
  • Credentials are encrypted using industry-standard encryption
  • No payment information is transmitted
  • Data is used solely for tax compliance purposes

Read our Privacy Policy for more information.

External Services

This plugin connects to WonderTax Labs (app.wonder.tax) to provide sales tax auditing and compliance services. It contacts that service:

  • When you connect your store — WonderTax Labs fetches from this site, once, with a one-time token, the store’s new API credentials and the store’s name (offered as the name of a new business); you sign in to WonderTax Labs yourself, and no account is identified or created from this site. The plugin then reads the connection’s status with a signed request.
  • Each time you open the plugin’s settings page — the plugin reads the connection’s status with a signed request and, when it is answered, sends the same signed report as the hourly sync.
  • When an order is created, updated or deleted — WooCommerce delivers the order to WonderTax Labs through the webhooks WonderTax Labs registers on connect.
  • Every hour — the plugin reports its version and the store’s tax settings, and reads whether WonderTax Labs answers the store’s checkout tax.
  • At checkout, only while WonderTax Labs answers your checkout tax (Reporta™) — the cart’s address and its lines, fees and shipping are sent, and the tax answered is applied. While it does, the plugin records your own tax settings, sets the tax basis to the shipping address and keeps “Enable taxes” on; your settings are put back when you disconnect or deactivate the plugin.
  • When you open the WonderTax Labs dashboard or switch Live/Test Mode — a signed link or request.
  • When you disconnect or deactivate the plugin — a signed notice tells WonderTax Labs that the plugin gave your own tax settings back (after a disconnect it also stops importing your orders). A notice WonderTax Labs does not accept is sent again with the hourly sync until it is, after a disconnect as well as once a deactivated plugin is active again.

Service URL: https://app.wonder.tax

Service Documentation: https://app.wonder.tax/integrations/woocommerce/docs

Privacy Policy: https://wonder.tax/privacy

Terms of Service: https://wonder.tax/tos

Data transmitted includes:
* Order information (amounts, customer location, product details)
* Store information (name, currency, timezone)
* The plugin’s version and the store’s tax settings (whether taxes are enabled, which address they are based on, whether standard tax rates exist, and whether prices are entered with tax), synced hourly
* At checkout, when your WonderTax Labs account requires them, the cart’s line details (amounts, tax classes, shipping) and the customer’s address
* No payment or sensitive financial data is transmitted

All connections use HTTPS encryption and credentials are stored securely.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “WonderTax Labs”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  5. Navigate to WooCommerce > WonderTax Labs
  6. Click “Connect to WonderTax Labs” to begin setup

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin
  6. Navigate to WooCommerce > WonderTax Labs
  7. Click “Connect to WonderTax Labs” to begin setup

After Installation

  1. Click “Connect to WonderTax Labs” on the settings page
  2. Log in to your WonderTax Labs account (or create one)
  3. Authorize the connection
  4. Done! Your orders will now sync automatically
sections.faq:
Do I need a WonderTax Labs account?

Yes, you need a WonderTax Labs account to use this plugin. You can sign up for free at app.wonder.tax.

What does Audita™ audit?

The sales tax your store charges. Every order is compared with the tax it owes, so an error is found before an auditor finds it.

Will my historical orders be imported?

Yes, WonderTax Labs can import your historical orders for comprehensive tax compliance tracking. This is done through the WonderTax Labs dashboard after connecting your store.

Is my data secure?

Yes, all credentials are encrypted using AES-256-GCM encryption, and all data transmission occurs over HTTPS. We follow industry best practices for security.

Which countries are supported?

Currently, WonderTax Labs focuses on US sales tax compliance. Support for additional countries may be added in the future.

How do I disconnect my store?

Navigate to WooCommerce > WonderTax Labs and click “Disconnect Store”. This tells WonderTax Labs to stop importing your orders, removes the webhooks WonderTax Labs registered on your store, deletes the WooCommerce API key the plugin created and the stored credentials, and, if WonderTax Labs answers your checkout tax, puts your own tax settings back. Your transactions already recorded in WonderTax Labs are kept there.

Where can I get support?

For support, please contact us at service@wonder.tax.

1.4.1 – 2026-11-13

  • Changed: Connecting no longer sends the site’s admin email address to WonderTax Labs; you sign in to WonderTax Labs yourself
  • Changed: Reconnecting keeps your working connection until WonderTax Labs confirms the new one
  • Changed: Disconnecting removes the API key the plugin created and the webhooks WonderTax Labs or earlier versions registered, and WonderTax Labs stops importing your orders
  • Changed: A disconnect that cannot put your own tax settings back right away changes nothing and asks you to try again
  • Changed: The connection status is read with a signed request
  • Changed: Each tax line shows the name of its jurisdiction
  • Changed: Each fee’s name is sent with the checkout, so WonderTax Labs can classify it
  • Changed: The settings page says whether WonderTax Labs answers your checkout tax
  • Added: A notice when WonderTax Labs has not answered several checkout tax requests in a row (a refusal of one cart, such as an address, does not count); it clears once WonderTax Labs answers again, starts or stops answering your checkout tax, or the store is disconnected
  • Added: Vertex, Quaderno and Stripe Tax are recognized as other tax engines, checked while WonderTax Labs answers your checkout tax too
  • Removed: The unused app-started connection flow and the plugin’s own webhook registration
  • Security: Every settings action requires the Manage WooCommerce capability
